Hi Vivek / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get StarForge integrated with Redwood. Per procurement's checklist I've attached the security artifacts you requested and a copy of our initial invoice. Quick summary below and next steps we need from you: 

Attachments: [StarForge_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (PDF), StarForge_Subprocessors_2026.csv (CSV), StarForge-Invoice-4521.pdf (PDF)]

What I'm sharing:
- SOC 2 report (attestation + control matrix) — see attached PDF and hosted link below.
- Current subprocessor register (CSV).
- Invoice for initial committed capacity (Invoice #4521).

What we need from Redwood to finish onboarding (procurement items):
1) A signed DPA (we can route via DocuSign). I can pre-fill most fields — please confirm the billing contact and PO number to include.
2) Purchase order (PO) confirmation or the procurement contact to route the invoice to (we normally require a PO number to start work).
3) Confirmation on any required subprocessor acceptance process — if Redwood needs more detail on any listed subprocessor, let me know and I can provide technical contacts.

DocuSign link to DPA (one-click signing): https://docusign.com/redirect/abcdef123456
Hosted SOC2 evidence (read-only): https://s3.amazonaws.com/starforge-security/soc2-2025.html
Subprocessor folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSF-subprocessors

If it helps, I can route the DPA to a legal contact at Redwood and add cost center/PO fields visible on the DocuSign envelope. Happy to sync for 15 minutes if you want to walk through the DPA.

Thanks,
Clara Ruiz
Head of GTM Ops, StarForge Systems
clara@starforge.io | +1 (415) 555-0198

Note: StarForge is happy to accept a PO or a signed DPA + invoice route. We typically wait for either a PO or payment instructions before enabling production keys.

- Can you add the name + email of a technical contact for any subprocessor entries that are third-party hosting vendors? That'll speed up our security team's spot checks.
- For the invoice: please include the remit-to address and Redwood's requested PO field (we use PO, cost center, and Redwood billing contact).

Billing/contact details for routing:
- Billing contact (preferred): Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
- Finance team PO email (procurement intake): laura_bennett@redwood.com (we'll loop Laura in internally once the DPA/PO fields are confirmed)
- Cost center: ENG-DEPENDENCIES (please add as a free-text field on the DocuSign envelope if possible)

We will route the DPA through DocuSign once we have the PO number or the invoice with remit info. Vanessa — can you confirm we'll accept the attached SOC 2 as-is for the initial go-live? If security needs anything else we'll flag it in 24 hours.

Clara, if you can confirm the DocuSign envelope includes fields for PO and cost center, we can sign the DPA and create the PO immediately. Otherwise, happy to hop on a 10-min call.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
